title: The Telegraph Test: cablese (telegraphese) output-compression benchmark for LLMs
description: Harness, frozen run artifacts, and verified results for the Telegraph Test: instructing LLMs to write in telegraphese ("cablese") cuts output tokens ~55% while models across four families recover the information at full fidelity. Deterministic, passage-anchored grading; no LLM judges in the truth path. Runs: baseline (bl5), cablese (cbl2), cross-model matrix (xm4), record-decode storage loop (rd1).
notes: Code: Apache-2.0. Data and benchmark artifacts (data/, ab/tasks2/): CC-BY-4.0. Companion write-up: 'Write Like It's 1866: LLMs Relearn Telegraphese'.
